pages.title: Invoices
pages.description: The Invoices page is where you create, send, and track invoices for your customers. Each invoice is linked to a Customer and can include one or more Products or services. Once you send an invoice, its status moves from draft to sent, then to paid once a Payment is recorded against it. You can also set up automatic reminder emails for invoices that are overdue.

pages.title: Dashboard
pages.description: The Dashboard gives you a quick overview of your business activity: outstanding Invoices, recent Payments, active Projects, and upcoming Tasks. It's the first page you see when you log in, and it's designed to answer 'what needs my attention today' at a glance.

keywords.description: A bill you send to a Customer for Products or services provided. An invoice tracks its own status (draft, sent, paid, overdue) and can be linked to one or more Payments.
A person or company you do business with. Customers have their own profile page showing their Invoices, Payments, and any active Projects.
A record of money received against an Invoice. A single invoice can be paid in full with one payment, or in several partial payments over time.
An item or service you sell. Products can be added as line items on an Invoice, with their own price and quantity.
A body of work for a Customer, made up of Tasks. Projects track overall progress and can be linked to Invoices for billing.
A single unit of work within a Project. Tasks have a due date and a status, and show up on your Dashboard when they're coming up soon.
Your plan for using the app itself, covering which features and usage limits are available to you.
A shareable link you can send to a Customer so they can review and approve design work before a Project moves forward.
Where you configure your account, business details, payment setup, and notification preferences.

Connect your AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) using https://slend.app/mcp to manage your work through chat.
      Workspace Owners can ask for summaries across all projects, check deadlines, create new projects and tasks, move work across stages, and update task notes.
      Team Members can ask what’s assigned to them, update progress on their checklist action items, and add notes to their tasks. They cannot see financial details, create projects, or edit work belonging to others.
      Option 1: ChatGPT
      Open ChatGPT and go to Settings → Connected apps.
      Click Add new → Add custom MCP server.
      Paste: https://slend.app/mcp and save.
      Log in with your Slend email and password to approve the connection.
      Option 2: Claude
      Open Claude and go to Settings → Customize.
      Click Add new → Add custom connector.
      Paste: https://slend.app/mcp and save.
      Log in with your Slend email and password to approve the connection.
